name: smwmusic-blaster-master-strike-of-justice-area
title: Blaster Master - Strike of Justice ~ Area 1 (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of the popular Area 1 theme from Blaster Master. Just played through Blaster Master Zero recently, and liked it quite a bit, so I thought I'd arrange the NES version of Area 1. Just like most other NES songs I've arranged, it's another NES slapper!!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.
